document: اتفاقية مستوى الخدمة بين الوزارة وزارة الاقتصاد - موقعة من الطرفين.pdf

root_cause.cluster_level_finding: _inject_arabic_structural_headings (RFC-027 D4) has two bugs preventing Arabic structural markers from being promoted to ATX headings

bug_1.name: prev_blank guard blocks consecutive markers
bug_1.issue: Requires blank line before each marker; OCR output flows continuously without blank lines; only first marker promoted, others fail
bug_1.impact: Depth-0 flat tree despite multiple structural sections

bug_2.name: len(t)<=60 char limit too tight
bug_2.issue: Arabic legal headings commonly 66-76+ chars; 60-char limit filters legitimate markers
bug_2.impact: Long article titles not promoted to headings

function.name: _inject_arabic_structural_headings
function.docstring: Promote al-bab/al-fasl/al-maddah lines to '#' headings (RFC-027 D4)
function.key_condition: if prev_blank and t and len(t) <= 60 and not _HEADING_RE.match(t):

evidence.test_continuous_ocr: Input: محتوى متصل بدون أسطر فارغة → Output: 0 headings promoted
evidence.test_with_blanks: Input: محتوى مع أسطر فارغة → Output: 4 headings promoted
evidence.test_long_title: Input: 90-char article title → Output: NOT promoted (fails len check)

specific_to_document.content_recovery: Went from 0 chars (FAIL) to 27,929 chars (MARGINAL) - OCR route fired
specific_to_document.structural_impact: 20-page SLA should have multiple sections/articles with hierarchy; tree is flat (depth-0)
specific_to_document.stored_vs_audit_divergence: Stored gate says PASS with cat_b_promoted but audit says MARGINAL with zero hierarchy
